'''Kixiaralu''', nicknamed '''Kixi''' for short, was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] who lived on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in the aftermath of the [[Great Galactic War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I learned a whole lot more from a girl called Kixi when I arrived here.|Larin Moxla, on her computer slicing training|<ref name="The Old Republic: Fatal Alliance">''[[The Old Republic: Fatal Alliance]]''</ref>}}
Born on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]], she became a skilled [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] on [[Computer/Legends|computer]] networks during the time of the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. After the [[Treaty of Coruscant]], she taught a disgraced [[Republic trooper]] named [[Larin Moxla]] about the abilities upon Moxla's arrival to Coruscant. When she combined Kixi's training with the basics of slicing she learned in the [[Republic Special Forces Division|Republic Special Forces]]' [[Blackstar Squad]], Moxla became a formidable slicer in her own right, and used those talents while trying to clean up the gang-dominated streets of Coruscant.

In [[3645 BBY]], Kixi was later captured by the [[Migrant Merchants' Guild]], a criminal organization on Coruscant, and forced to slice into computer systems for two years before being discovered by a [[Voidhound|smuggler]]. She assisted her rescuer by accessing and sabotaging the personal files of a criminal, the smuggler was pursuing.

==Behind the scenes==
Kixi was first mentioned in the [[2010]] novel ''[[The Old Republic: Fatal Alliance]]'', written by [[Sean Williams]]. Player Characters of the Smuggler class in [[BioWare]]'s massively multiplayer online roleplaying game (MMORPG) ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' meet Kixi during their storyline on Coruscant. The player has the option to either free her from imprisonment, take her into custody, or kill her, depending on dialog choices.
